protocolDosing.notes: community/anecdotal; no human studies; t½ ~6–12 h is unverified community claim; women use 0.5–2 mg/day

mechanismOfAction.summary: Steroidal SARM with dual mechanism: partial AR agonism plus functional myostatin inhibition via follistatin upregulation.
mechanismOfAction.description: 5α-DHT C17-methyl ester derivative; partial AR agonist (does not induce full N/C-terminal AR interaction unlike DHT) plus functional myostatin inhibitor via follistatin (FST) upregulation — the only characterized SARM with this dual mechanism. FST induction more potent than DHT in C2C12 myoblasts. CAS discrepancy: 1370003-76-1 confirmed by PubChem CID 119058028; 431579-34-9 is an unverified alternate.
